topic: drill-panel.test.tsx callers when onOpenDrill becomes required
lesson: RULING on S-0025-d216, already in the recorded contract: frontend/src/features/mis/drill-panel.test.tsx is in write_scope. Its 17 StatementView callers omit onOpenDrill, so when the fallback is deleted and the prop becomes required they must each pass the lifted factory. Do NOT keep the fallback, an optional prop or a default to avoid editing them - that preserves the old ownership path and is the fourth compatibility shim this story has had to remove. Update the call sites only; leave what those tests assert about the drill panel untouched.
